intervals.label: planned start of data taking
intervals.locator: arXiv:2606.11039 (PDF), closing paragraph before the acknowledgements
intervals.note: Planned date stated in the SHiP Collaboration's 2026 proceedings (arXiv:2606.11039), which also say the BDF is foreseen to be commissioned with beam by 2033. Recorded as approximate because the schedule is still moving: a May 2024 CERN Courier interview gave an earlier aim (facility towards the end of 2030, detector in 2031).
intervals.quote: Approved in 2024 and to be built within the coming years at the CERN SPS, it will begin data taking in 2033.

name: SHiP detector
notes: Not yet constructed; the 2033 start in the intervals and placement is `planned: true` and rests on the SHiP Collaboration's 2026 proceedings (arXiv:2606.11039), per experiment:ship notes.

placements.locator: arXiv:2606.11039 (PDF), closing paragraph before the acknowledgements (start date); official SHiP site (ECN3 location)
placements.note: Not yet built; planned placement at the ECN3 cavern per the official site's reference to the 'High-Intensity ECN3 Facility'. Planned start (2033) from the SHiP Collaboration's 2026 proceedings (arXiv:2606.11039); see experiment:ship notes.
placements.quote: Approved in 2024 and to be built within the coming years at the CERN SPS, it will begin data taking in 2033.

summary.plain: The planned SHiP detector: a beam-dump target, a muon shield, an empty decay volume, and a spectrometer, built to catch the decays of hypothetical new particles that could otherwise pass through matter unnoticed.
summary.technical: Planned beam-dump/decay-volume detector at ECN3: heavy target absorbing the SPS proton beam, active muon shield, large vacuum decay vessel and downstream spectrometer/calorimeter for reconstructing displaced decays of feebly interacting particles.

technology.value: High-intensity proton beam-dump on a heavy target, followed by a muon shield, a large vacuum decay volume and a downstream spectrometer/calorimeter system to reconstruct decays of feebly interacting long-lived particles
